text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"Guh... Heheh, you got me... 
To think you harbored such strong feelings 
for us—"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: M-My chest is so full I can't move...!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"Hehehe... Did your blood sugar spike and 
make you sleepy? 
Or are you surrendering before our full 
power!?"

text_block_list.name: Shy Student
text_block_list.text:
!? Taiki-senpai moved! 
But how can she fight back when she's 
usually so rough around the edges—

text_block_list.name: Carefree Student
text_block_list.text:
"W-What is this...!? 
Delicate cooking... coming from 
Taiki-senpai!?"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"(Suzuka, Fukukitaru, Universe... 
Your feelings came through loud and 
clear!)"

text_block_list.name: Spectating Student A
text_block_list.text:
"B-But what about Earth!? That girl hasn't 
produced a single confection this entire 
time...!"

text_block_list.name: Spectating Student B
text_block_list.text:
"N-No, wait! That's— 
Some brown thing is gradually taking 
shape! Could it be—"

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"...Chocolate. 
'Cooking' being created from the hands of 
Sounds of Earth."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"That is—a collapse of causality. 
Right now—a 'singularity' is being laid 
bare."

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"Fufu... The melodia I received from 
Universe-san— 
that melody still echoing in my heart is 
making me 'push my limits'!"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"You hit us with some mighty big 
feelings... 
but we won't back down either! This... is 
our counter!"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: "Now, eat this! This is our—"

text_block_list.name: Taiki & Earth
text_block_list.text:
"The Marshmallow Chocolate Cracker 
Sandwich... S'more"!! 
"Il Mio Cuore di Cioccolato"!!

text_block_list.name: All Three
text_block_list.text: Waaaahhh!?!?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"T-This is... The bittersweet chocolate 
followed by a wave of sweetness... 
A rich yet heartwarming flavor—just like a 
gentle hug!"

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"A-And... by combining it with our cookie 
statues, it looks like they're sharing 
cookies with each other!?"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"This is a barbecue staple from my home, 
straight from Mama's recipe. 
A taste of memories eaten together with 
family, YES."

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"...My races. Suzuka's races. Fukukitaru's 
races. 
Everything we've done so far was possible 
because everyone was there, YES."

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"So... you are all family, too! We will 
keep running together forever! 
We'll compete! We'll have barbecues! 
FOREVER!"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"That is my wish. 
These are the sweets packed with all my 
feelings, YES."

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
"...Sounds of Earth's chocolate. 
It is... 'orthodox'. Shaped like... a 
'heart'."

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"...You see, Universe. I wanted to prepare 
something worthy of responding to that 
magnificent monolith and create a true 
'session' between us."

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"The feeling you gave me—'do your best'. 
With that held close to my heart, driven 
solely by the impulse to 'do my best', I 
threw myself into intense practice."

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"I couldn't create a masterpiece like that 
monolith. After endless trial and error... 
and all that effort, all I could manage in 
the end was... ordinary, plain chocolate."

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"But you know what? I've come to think 
that's just fine. Because, see... 
Isn't this shaped like the 'heart' of 
someone who 'did their best'?"

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"...What do you think, Universe? Has my 
heart resonated with yours?"

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
".........Yeah. You 'did your best', 
Sounds of Earth."

text_block_list.name: Suzuka & Fukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"'...Taiki!' 
'...Taiki-san!'"

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text: Sounds of Earth...

text_block_list.name: All Three
text_block_list.text: —Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Spectating Student A
text_block_list.text:
"...H-Hey? Who ended up winning this 
thing, anyway?"

text_block_list.name: Former Troubled Student
text_block_list.text:
"...Does winning or losing really matter? 
What's far more important is—"

text_block_list.name: Former Troubled Student
text_block_list.text:
Putting your whole heart into conveying 
your feelings is so passionate!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
—If there's ever a feeling you're holding 
onto inside...

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
First, please try giving it your all to 
deliver it!

text_block_list.name: Neo Universe
text_block_list.text:
That 'impact' will definitely resonate in 
their heart—

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"It will create a beautiful melody—which 
will echo through their soul and return to 
you in words."

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"YES! Just like the feelings zooming and 
flying around inside my chest right now!"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"—Which means! To express all of these 
feelings! 
I'm going to give every single one of you 
a full-power hug, YES!"

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: "...Huh?! W-Wait—not—"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: I LOVE you all so much~~!!
